what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Sudan in Morocco: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4656 Sudanese asylum seekers in Morocco, 0.5% of all asylum seekers from Sudan.
Refugees from Sudan, a separate group, live mostly in Chad, South Sudan, Libya and Ethiopia.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Sudan from 1996 to 2018 and from 2020 to 2025, at war level in most of those years, with the RSF among the opponents since 2020.
It also records an interstate armed conflict between South Sudan and Sudan in 2012.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2001 at 5 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, the main year of displacement in the data.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Morocco.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Morocco only.
